text: The sources do not contradict each other. Hansen's data shows a significant tree-cover loss event of 67.7 ha in 2020, but this loss occurred within an area that already had less than 30% tree cover, hence JRC did not classify it as forest in 2020. The JRC dataset uses a different classification system, focusing on areas with at least 30% tree cover, while Hansen tracks changes in tree cover regardless of the initial cover percentage. Therefore, the datasets are complementary rather than contradictory.
